record.paper_title: Constructive Field Theory and Applications: Perspectives and Open Problems
record.original_question: Glue the ultraviolet construction of the large-N φ⁴ theory in three dimensions to the infrared analysis of continuous symmetry breaking so as to control the continuous-symmetry-broken phase without an ultraviolet cutoff.

evidence.quote: One could also glue the ultraviolet construction of φ4 3 to the infrared continuous symmetry breaking analysis of [Ba2] to control the large N-component φ4 3 model in the continuous symmetry broken phase without an ultraviolet cutoff.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the N-component scalar Euclidean field theory on $\mathbb{R}^3$ with O(N)-symmetric quartic interaction, formally given by the action
$$S(\varphi) = \int_{\mathbb{R}^3}\Big(\tfrac{1}{2}|\nabla\varphi(x)|^2 + \tfrac{1}{2}m^2|\varphi(x)|^2 + \tfrac{\lambda}{N}\big(|\varphi(x)|^2\big)^2\Big)\,dx,$$
where $\varphi:\mathbb{R}^3\to\mathbb{R}^N$, the coupling $\lambda>0$ is fixed, and the mass parameter $m^2$ is taken in the regime corresponding to spontaneous breaking of the continuous O(N) symmetry. By a "construction" of the theory we mean rigorously defining a probability measure on a suitable space of distributions whose moments are the Schwinger functions of the model, after carrying out renormalization (mass and possibly coupling counterterms) and removing any ultraviolet regularization.

Problem: Construct, in the limit $N\to\infty$ (with $\lambda/N$ scaled as above), the $\varphi^4_3$ Euclidean measure in the continuous-symmetry-broken phase without an ultraviolet cutoff. More precisely, combine an ultraviolet construction of the $\varphi^4_3$ theory (removal of the UV cutoff via renormalization) with an infrared analysis of continuous symmetry breaking, producing a translation-invariant probability measure on distributional fields $\varphi:\mathbb{R}^3\to\mathbb{R}^N$ that:
(i) is invariant under spatial translations;
(ii) exhibits spontaneous breaking of the O(N) symmetry (i.e., extremal states have nonzero vacuum expectation $\langle\varphi\rangle\neq 0$, with massless Goldstone modes);
(iii) is the limit, as the ultraviolet cutoff is removed, of regularized renormalized measures.

Establish existence of such a measure and prove its basic properties (translation invariance, clustering within pure phases, and the Goldstone behavior of the transverse two-point function at long distances).
artifact.status_search_result: Recent constructive work (e.g., phase-transition results for $\varphi^4_3$ in Comm. Math. Phys. 2022) establishes phase transitions for $\varphi^4_3$ with fixed UV cutoff, and separate works address infrared continuous symmetry breaking. No source found that completes the gluing of the UV construction to the IR symmetry-breaking analysis at large N without an ultraviolet cutoff. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Phase Transitions for φ⁴₃
status_evidence.snippet: Estimates on expectation values with a fixed ultraviolet cutoff K uniform in K; phase transition construction with UV regularization.
status_evidence.claim: Existing constructive results address phase transitions for φ⁴₃ but typically with a UV cutoff or not in the large-N symmetry-broken setting.

status_evidence.title: Ultraviolet Stability in Field Theory. The φ⁴₃ Model
status_evidence.snippet: Generating functional for Schwinger functions requires space and ultraviolet cut-offs.
status_evidence.claim: UV construction of φ⁴₃ is established, but combining it with IR symmetry breaking analysis in the broken phase remains a separate task.
